baseline.stage_rule: build a NEW G4-C stage at the run commit; never reuse stage-stage-2026111* bytes as R-REV6 evidence
baseline.rootfs_rule: frozen rootfs only ever read; stage build and every container use a fresh writable per-case copy; T0/T1 frozen hash equality enforced by the runner gate
baseline.network_rule: --network none; 0 HTTP/TCP; synthetic Fake only; no Key; LiveGate BLOCKED
baseline.window_rule: single-writer exclusive OCI window approved by Lead; runner refuses to start if containers exist, dirty worktree, non-canonical rootfs/deps, or existing output directory

per_case_required: uid_map/peercred for trusted and candidate containers
attempt DB + broker DB read-only snapshots + ledger snapshot JSON
checks[] with expected vs observed and explicit limitation/NOT_RUN reasons

digest_bindings.name: prepared_digest==claim.request_digest
digest_bindings.note: business/prepared digest binds the trusted prepared request to the Broker Claim

digest_bindings.name: payload_digest==receipt.raw_sha256
digest_bindings.note: the exact Fake payload bytes bind to the Fake receipt

digest_bindings.name: prepared_digest != payload_digest
digest_bindings.note: these are different digests by construction; never asserted equal

digest_bindings.name: attempt.call_id/reservation_id uniqueness per business identity
digest_bindings.note: same business request replay creates no second attempt/reservation/receipt

digest_bindings.name: held == reserved for PENDING
digest_bindings.note: conservative hold is never released or converted to FREE without an authoritative Broker terminal state

digest_bindings.name: settled exactly once per reservation
digest_bindings.note: Broker OK/FAILED is terminal and not re-settled or reversed

steps: T0 preflight: frozen main rootfs/deps canonical hash, git clean, containers empty, disk >= 2.5 GiB
create frozen rootfs work copy + verify canonical hash; build Stage at run HEAD with rootfs rebound to the work copy (adapter build container) + validate_stage_g4
run R6-01..R6-13 sequentially, fresh rootfs work copy per case, fresh evidence dir, containers must be empty between cases
T1 postflight: frozen rootfs/deps hash equality with T0, stage manifest/tree hash recorded, containers_after=[], evidence index + sha256 manifest
freeze evidence root (read-only), write A_NEXT_RREV6_L2_REPORT.md appendix
abort_conditions: frozen rootfs/deps hash drift (T0 != T1) => STOP, keep evidence, report drift
any real Key/HTTP/TCP/provider call observed => STOP
duplicate Fake/settlement, PENDING released as FREE, unapproved tool reachable => STOP
container cleanup failure or leftover podman state => STOP

cases.goal: real DSH Echo: one provider dispatch, one receipt, one settlement
cases.method: launch candidate mode=dsh scenario=echo against fresh stage; synthetic prompt G6_ECHO_<nonce>

cases.goal: real DSH Tool: two legal provider dispatches in one run are both accepted
cases.method: scenario=tool with approved skill_lookup schema; two provider requests (tool-call round + final text round)
checks: no ATTEMPT_ALREADY_STARTED for the second legal step

cases.goal: real DSH Resume two-turn: turn1 echo + turn2 resume against the same session store
cases.method: two sequential candidate containers sharing run_dir/candidate-session; turn1 scenario=echo prompt G6_RESUME_ALPHA, turn2 scenario=resume prompt G6_RESUME_BETA
checks: no false replay rejection of the legal second turn

cases.goal: same business request replay at DSH level is refused before a second provider dispatch (documented limitation); byte-identical UDS replay is covered by R6-04B
cases.method: after R6-01 state source (or same case run twice): run scenario=echo with the exact same session id + prompt; DSH terminal error expected

cases.goal: byte-identical same-business-request replay through the real candidate UDS (NO_DUP dispatch)
cases.method: candidate-mode hold + probe steps valid,replay (byte-identical payload, same business identity)

cases.goal: pre-Reserve timeout observed at the request layer; nothing reserved or sent
cases.method: deadline_ms=800 + test-only delay hook before_reserve 2500ms, real DSH echo request
cases.injection: controller test-only delay hook (existing, env gated)
checks: no fabricated dispatch_seq for a never-entered request

cases.goal: post-Reserve revocation: no Fake send, PENDING/held, first cause preserved after recovery
cases.method: revocation document written at after_reserve_before_send marker; controller gate re-reads revocation; restart recovery pass
cases.injection: existing revocation document + test-only delay hook + trusted restart
checks: recovery diagnostics record the receipt observation separately
replay rejected; no settle/fail; no FREE

cases.goal: post-send timeout: Fake received bytes, deadline before result, conservative held
cases.method: scenario=stream (receipt then stall), deadline_ms=800, trusted restart recovery
checks: recovery keeps PENDING/held; no premature settle/fail

cases.goal: Controller crash mid-request: no duplicate dispatch; recovery conservative; replay no-op
cases.method: trusted controller crash hook after_attempt_start_before_fake_send (os._exit) then real restart/reconcile; replay same identity
checks: one attempt row, no second Fake/settlement

cases.goal: Controller hard stop / socket lost mid-request (SIGKILL fragment, not just hook)
cases.method: kill trusted container with SIGKILL at after_reserve_before_send marker; candidate DSH observes stream loss; restart recovery
cases.injection: host podman kill + delay marker (test-side only, no src hook)
checks: held>0; evidence records the exact wire window
limitation: not a full nanosecond SIGKILL sweep (F5-R6)

cases.goal: Candidate crash while Controller remains alive: no duplicate dispatch, conservative cost
cases.method: real DSH candidate killed with SIGKILL at after_reserve_before_send marker (deadline 800ms so the worker aborts pre-send); controller keeps serving; replay from a fresh candidate
cases.injection: host podman kill of the candidate container at the test delay marker
checks: trusted container still running after candidate death
candidate exit code recorded as crash
limitations: test-only delay widens a real pre-send window; no production hook
a second variant with deadline 30000 is recorded separately (Fake may already be sent) and judged exactly-once, not held

cases.goal: Fake crash mid-request: conservative uncertain hold, no double settle, recovery preserves
cases.method: scenario=stream (Fake writes receipt then stalls); watcher kills fake_provider.py after the first receipt; restart recovery
cases.injection: host podman exec /proc SIGKILL of the Fake child (test-side only)

expected.note: Broker terminal FAILED is authoritative; conservative WORST_CASE_HELD archival, no double charge

checks: recovery diagnostics record the reconciliation observation

cases.goal: Broker down/restart conservation: PENDING reservation held, no release, no double charge
cases.method: kill broker subprocess at after_reserve_before_send marker (before Claim); restart trusted (broker respawn on same DB); reconcile
checks: Broker DB single reservation row, no settle/fail row
reconcile reads restored Broker status PENDING, keeps held

cases.goal: usage/hash reconciliation over all real-DSH cases: authentic digest joins, no cross-digest conflation
cases.method: post-hoc audit over R6-01..R6-12 read-only evidence snapshots
